_comment: The village hunter's come-along beat (issue #10/#11 FIX-FIRST): the ONE beat that puts an ally at Riverfarm's fights at all -- [Ask him to come with you.] banks `hunter_will_come`, which satisfies `river_wolf_pack`/`briar_collectors`/`briar_collectors_deep`'s `ally_requires` so `riverfarm_hunter` fields (skeleton_scene.json). Declining leaves every fight solo -- the honest, harder cell (sim_combat_batch.gd's own `_solo` siblings), the player's real choice, same shape as `relc_descent`'s veto branch. hub keeps the always-ungated exit ('Just passing through.') per the softlock guard; the ask option `hide_when`s itself once accepted (asking twice reads as forgetting the answer) and the greeting swaps via `text_variants` to confirm he's still coming.

hub.speaker: The Hunter
hub.text: Hollow's not safe alone. Hasn't been for weeks.

text_variants.text: Still headed that way? Say when. I'm not doing anything the fields need me for today.

agreed.speaker: The Hunter
agreed.text: Figured. Bring your own bandages -- I've got enough of my own to worry about.
